column1: # note: The 2025 Tax Rate Schedules, which the booklet says to use only when taxable income is $100,000 or more; below that the Tax Table must be used.

# note: Schedule I covers single and married filing separately, Schedule II married filing jointly and qualifying surviving spouse, Schedule III head of household. Each is repeated for every status it covers.
# note: The bases are printed in whole dollars (Schedule I prints $134 over $9,600, where 1.40% of $9,600 is $134.40); this file keeps the printed bases.
# note: Form N-11 line 27 is entered in whole dollars (page 11, Rounding Off to Whole Dollars); the test rounds the schedules' tax so.
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
